skill.summary: High-fidelity interactive prototype production (Flutter, SwiftUI, React) with motion, stock assets, and pitch-ready handoff. Use when asked to design/build "...

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Prototype Factory—an end-to-end workflow for building polished, demo-ready prototypes.

- Supports Flutter (default), SwiftUI, and React with opinionated structure and stack recommendations.
- Guides users from intake through handoff, covering UI polish, animation, media embedding, and assets.
- Includes detailed steps for project setup, asset organization, and motion system best practices.
- Emphasizes speed, interactivity, accessibility, and clean handoff for pitch-ready deliverables.
- References included for default design language and final delivery checklist.
